High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready copy of the Players Committee errata card [[Allegations Of Corruption (PC Errata 2018 E card)]] (the earlier errata image marked "E"), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]]. strangewayes re-set the card for printing, so small details (fonts, colours, the gold "E" errata mark, some icons) differ from the Holotable image; the wording is that of this version.

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Errata/Dark_E/Allegations Of Corruption EF _ E.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/1kKnFm4978GtcbDp60wn15Gk6JSvZlYLv/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Allegations Of Corruption EF _ E.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,340,960 bytes, SHA-256 <code>910cb187777488f72ce111abb4bb3b62c5be9c50b0e0de87c007b0ddc05bd4c9</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 44.0, 47.5, 72.5, 57.0 px); resized: no; no other change.

The regular face of this card on its article is [[:File:Cor-D-allegationsofcorruption-E-2018-07-08.gif]]; this file is shown there as the High-Res Scan.

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project. Fair use rationale: this is an image of a copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. (errata by the Players Committee). It is used only to identify and study the card on this non-commercial fan wiki, it does not replace any product sold today, and no free equivalent exists.
